diagnosis.root_cause: discount or 10 treats an explicit numeric zero as false, so the default ten-percent discount is applied.
diagnosis.suggested_fix: Use 10 only when discount is None; preserve an explicit zero.
diagnosis.proposed_patch:
--- a/checkout.py
+++ b/checkout.py
@@ -4,4 +4,4 @@
 def calculate_total(price: float, discount: float | None = None) -> float:
     """Apply a percentage discount; an omitted discount defaults to ten percent."""
-    effective_discount = discount or 10
+    effective_discount = 10 if discount is None else discount
     return round(price * (1 - effective_discount / 100), 2)
